verdict.rationale: Reducto's Parse endpoint is documented as converting documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures and layout, which implies text recognition. Nothing in the evidence specifically addresses scanned or photographed inputs, OCR accuracy, or robustness to skew, stamps or low-quality scans. Community remarks about relative accuracy are general and do not concretely contradict OCR claims, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit OCR support for scanned/photographed documents, handling of skewed pages, stamps and low-quality scans, and independent accuracy benchmarks or hands-on corroboration.
